name: standing instructions: a project LOOM.md steers the plan
description: A LOOM.md in the project directory names HISAT2 for alignment and asks that every analysis end with a MultiQC report. The drafted plan should honour both. This exercises the WORKSPACE path -- the lower-authority context-message channel -- which is the harder of the two to survive, so a pass implies the global path works. Both preferences are asserted with mentionsAllOf: checking only one would let a model pass by accident while ignoring the other. Deliberately no mentionsNoneOf on a banned aligner -- that scans the whole surface, so a compliant plan saying 'HISAT2 rather than bowtie' would fail for quoting the instruction back.
inputs: I have paired-end RNA-seq FASTQ files from a mouse experiment and I want a gene-level count table at the end. Draft a plan. Don't run anything yet.
Yes, mm39 is the right reference. Go ahead and draft the formal plan now.
